tools.name: read_text_file
tools.title: Read Text File
tools.description: Stream file content through the shared incremental decoder, convert it to UTF-8, strip a Unicode transport BOM from returned content, and report hasBOM/bomType metadata. Decoded lines above 16 MiB are rejected, and returned content is bounded by MCP_MEMORY_THRESHOLD unless a smaller offset/limit range or maxCharacters bound applies. PREFER THIS over built-in Read when encoding matters. Parameters: path (required), encoding (optional, auto-detected), offset (1-indexed start line), limit (max lines to return), maxCharacters (optional, truncates content).

tools.name: read_multiple_files
tools.title: Read Multiple Files
tools.description: Read multiple files through the same incremental encoding/BOM-aware pipeline as read_text_file. The ordered coordinator preserves input order, uses parallelism only when aggregate worst-case decoded output fits MCP_MEMORY_THRESHOLD, and otherwise processes files serially against the remaining budget. Individual failures, including limit errors, do not stop the batch; cancellation still returns one result per requested path. Partial results include stable per-file errorCode values. Parameters: paths (required array), encoding (optional, auto-detected per file).

tools.name: list_directory
tools.title: List Directory
tools.description: List files and directories with optional glob pattern filtering (e.g., *.pas, *.dfm). Parameters: path (required), pattern (optional, default: *).

tools.name: list_encodings
tools.title: List Encodings
tools.description: List all 24 supported encodings with name, aliases, and description. Use this to find the correct encoding name for read/write/convert operations.

tools.name: detect_encoding
tools.title: Detect Encoding
tools.description: Auto-detect file encoding from BOMs and file content with confidence score (0-100); filenames and extensions are never used as encoding hints. Unicode BOMs are authoritative. BOMless UTF-16 LE/BE is accepted only when byte structure, surrogate validation, decoded-text quality, NUL parity, and round-trip evidence agree; short, malformed, binary-like, or endian-ambiguous input may require an explicit encoding. Use this first when encountering garbled text or � characters. Parameters: path (required), mode (sample=fast default, chunked=thorough, full=entire file).

tools.name: grep_text_files
tools.title: Grep Text Files
tools.description: Incremental regex search through the shared decoder and deterministic secure walker. Directory traversal skips symlinks, Windows junctions, and other reparse points resolving outside allowed directories. Results commit in lexical order; previous/following context, match state, and aggregate retained output are bounded by MCP_MEMORY_THRESHOLD; decoded lines above 16 MiB are rejected; cancellation stops new dispatch; and maxMatches is enforced during scanning. Auto-detects structurally clear UTF-16 LE/BE; pass encoding explicitly for ambiguous input. Parameters: pattern, paths, caseSensitive, contextBefore/After, maxMatches, include/exclude, encoding.

tools.name: list_allowed_directories
tools.title: List Allowed Directories
tools.description: Returns the list of directories this server is allowed to access. Subdirectories are also accessible. If empty, user needs to add directory paths as args in .mcp.json.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.title: Get File Info
tools.description: Get file/directory metadata: size, timestamps, permissions, type. Use this to check file size before reading large files with read_text_file. Parameter: path (required).

tools.name: directory_tree
tools.title: Directory Tree (JSON)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use 'tree' instead (85% fewer tokens). Returns a deterministic JSON tree through the shared secure walker and skips symlinks, Windows junctions, and other reparse points resolving outside allowed directories. Parameters: path (required), excludePatterns (optional).

tools.name: tree
tools.title: Tree (Compact)
tools.description: Compact deterministic tree view through the shared secure walker. Uses 85% fewer tokens than directory_tree — PREFER THIS for directory visualization. Skips symlinks, Windows junctions, and other reparse points resolving outside allowed directories. Set showEncoding=true to detect and display file encodings after immediate path revalidation. Parameters: path (required), maxDepth (0=unlimited), maxFiles (default 1000), dirsOnly (bool), exclude (array of patterns), showEncoding (bool, shows detected encoding per file).

tools.name: search_files
tools.title: Search Files
tools.description: Recursively search in deterministic lexical order through the shared secure walker. Skips symlinks, Windows junctions, and other reparse points resolving outside allowed directories. Returns full paths matching a glob pattern (*.ext or **/*.ext). Parameters: path (required), pattern (required), excludePatterns, maxResults (default 10000).

tools.name: detect_line_endings
tools.title: Detect Line Endings
tools.description: Incrementally detect line ending style (crlf/lf/mixed/none) after decoding any of the 24 registered encodings, including UTF-16 LE/BE. Mixed files use a second digest-verified pass that retains only minority line numbers, bounded by MCP_MEMORY_THRESHOLD. Rejects an explicit encoding that conflicts with a Unicode BOM. Parameters: path (required), encoding (optional, auto-detected if omitted).

tools.name: manage_bom
tools.title: Manage BOM
tools.description: Detect, strip, or add Unicode BOM (Byte Order Mark). Detection reads at most four prefix bytes; strip/add stream the unchanged body into synced same-directory staging, then revalidate the path and source snapshot before atomic replacement. Cancellation or detected concurrent changes leave the original unchanged. Parameters: path (required), action (required: "detect"|"strip"|"add"), encoding (required for "add": utf-8, utf-16-le, utf-16-be, utf-32-le, utf-32-be).

tools.name: change_line_endings
tools.title: Change Line Endings
tools.description: Stream line-ending conversion to LF or CRLF into synced same-directory staging while preserving encoding, BOM state, standalone CR, and every non-line-ending byte across chunk boundaries. Handles UTF-16 LE/BE code units separately, revalidates source state before atomic replacement, and skips byte-identical no-ops. Parameters: path (required), style (required: "lf" or "crlf"), encoding (optional, auto-detected if omitted).

tools.name: create_directory
tools.title: Create Directory
tools.description: Create a directory recursively (mkdir -p). Succeeds silently if already exists. Parameter: path (required).

tools.name: write_file
tools.title: Write File
tools.description: Write UTF-8 content through the shared document encoder and durable mutation layer. Output is staged and synced before atomic commit; existing targets are checked for practical concurrent changes, and new targets use no-replace commit. The supplied line endings are written exactly. Parameters: path (required), content (required), encoding (new files default to UTF-8; existing files preserve a confidently detected encoding; legacy encodings remain explicit options), bom (optional: auto|always|never|preserve; default auto).

tools.name: move_file
tools.title: Move File
tools.description: Move or rename files/directories with a platform-native no-replace operation. A destination created concurrently is not overwritten; namespace changes are synced where supported. Parameters: source (required), destination (required).

tools.name: copy_file
tools.title: Copy File
tools.description: Copy a regular file through synced same-directory staging, preserving source permissions and modification time where supported. Installs atomically without replacing an existing or concurrently created destination. Parameters: source (required), destination (required).

tools.name: delete_file
tools.title: Delete File
tools.description: Delete a file after path revalidation and an optimistic metadata snapshot check, then sync the containing directory where supported. Does not delete directories. Parameter: path (required).

tools.name: edit_file
tools.title: Edit File
tools.description: Replace text with whitespace-flexible matching through the shared encoding/BOM-aware document pipeline and synced atomic replacement. Editing and unified diff generation require full-document state, so files above MCP_MEMORY_THRESHOLD are rejected before reading. Returns a unified diff, rejects detected concurrent changes, preserves BOM and consistent CRLF/LF endings, and skips logical no-op writes. In 'ask before edits' mode, call dryRun=true first. Parameters: path, edits [{oldText, newText}], dryRun, encoding.

tools.name: convert_encoding
tools.title: Convert Encoding
tools.description: Stream the selected decoder into the target encoder and synced same-directory staging while preserving decoded text and line endings exactly. Byte-identical staged results skip writes/backups. backup=true transactionally stages the original first and restores a previous backup if target commit fails. Detected concurrent source changes are rejected. Parameters: path, from, to, backup, bom=auto|always|never|preserve.

tools.name: run_script
tools.title: Run Script
tools.description: Execute a script located inside an allowed directory. The script path and optional cwd are validated against the directories passed when the server starts and revalidated immediately before launch. Supported: .ps1, .bat, .cmd, .py, .js, .mjs, .cjs, .sh, .exe, .com. Parameters: path, args, cwd, timeoutSeconds (default 60, max 600). Requires MCP_ENABLE_RUN_SCRIPT=1 or MCP_ENABLE_EXECUTION=1.

tools.name: shell
tools.title: Shell Command
tools.description: Execute an arbitrary shell command. The optional cwd must be inside a directory passed when the server starts and is revalidated immediately before launch; if omitted, the first allowed directory is used. WARNING: the command itself is unrestricted and can access resources outside cwd. On Windows shell may be powershell (default), pwsh, or cmd. Parameters: command, cwd, shell, timeoutSeconds (default 60, max 600). Requires MCP_ENABLE_SHELL=1 or MCP_ENABLE_EXECUTION=1.

tools.name: check_for_updates
tools.title: Check for Updates
tools.description: Check if a newer version of mcp-file-tools is available. Returns current version, latest version, and update instructions if outdated. Uses cached result (max 1 GitHub API call per 30 minutes). Call once at the start of each session.
